# What each fixture reads, run by the crate (tests/shared.rs) and by Core
# (Localization-Tests/WordsIniCasesTests.cs), so the two readers agree by test.

# file | language | call | key | args | expected

# call: get (no arguments: items and selectors stay as written), format, count.
# args: - for none; else ;-separated, Name=value for a named one; a count's number.
# expected: \n is a line break and \\ a backslash.
